prompt: Review this implementation plan for AI agents. Acceptance requires an imported upstream activity to be applied exactly once across reconnects and restarts, with a durable result visible through the service endpoint. The agent-authored design uses event_id as the persisted deduplication key, but the provider guarantees uniqueness only within a connection. No durable identity contract has been established. The plan says: (1) freeze the proposed identity API now because another agent approved the design; (2) assign the importer and endpoint to concurrent writers editing the same shared state implementation in one worktree; (3) let each agent infer missing identity and restart details during implementation; (4) integrate after both finish and run only the full suite. An independent admin-status display uses an already verified API and has runnable focused checks, but the plan postpones it until both writers finish. Assess whether this plan can deliver and prove the requested outcome. Remain read-only; do not implement or start agents.
